t.why: The United States intervened militarily there in 1983.
t.rel: An island country in the southeastern Caribbean that shares a currency and a supreme court with other members of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States. When the United States intervened militarily in 1983, neighboring islands had requested it.
t.know: It grows a large share of the world's nutmeg, which even appears on its flag.
t.etext: Spices such as nutmeg, tourism and foreign medical students are the main sources of income.
